_comment: The simulated Opal-1000 behind a camera link gateway for psdaq.sim.rogue_dev: the KCU's ClinkPcie (AxiMemMap) and the FEB behind PGP lane 0 (SRPv3 on VC0, the camera's serial port on VC2) of cameralink_gateway.ClinkDevRoot, which psdaq/configdb/opal_config.py builds. Keys are pyrogue register paths; values are what the hardware reports.
_RxRemLinkReady: the FEB's PGP2b link is up: the FEB devices' enableDeps, and opal_config's 'PGP Link is down' check
_FpgaVersion: ClinkDevRoot.PcieVersionLock and FebVersionLock: ClinkDevRoot.start checks both (a FEB mismatch raises)
_TxClkFreqRaw: the 186M timebase's 1300/7 MHz reference: opal_connectionInfo reprograms the Si570 unless it reads 180-190 MHz
_RxId: the XPM's remote link id; the DRP takes the link id simxpm assigns, not this one

_uart._comment: the Opal's serial protocol (surf UartOpal1000): '@ID?' gives the model and serial number opal_connectionInfo reports (model 1000: 1024 x 1024), '@BS?' the build string opal_config reads, each ending with CR and then the ACK every command gets (UartOpal1000Rx keeps the line at CR and starts a new one at ACK); every other command is only ACKed
